question: How was Arjuna shown the supreme form?
premises: he showed supreme form by self-yoga
inference: The vision is a gracious self-yoga disclosure
uncertainties: tavārjunedaṃ is a fused triple form
plain_english: The blessed Lord said: by me, being gracious, this supreme form was shown to you, Arjuna, by self-yoga; radiant, world, infinite, primal, which by other than you has not been seen before.
